description: This file defines a Java class 'MockLegacyDoorWindowSensor' which extends 'MockLegacySecurityDevice' and implements 'MockSensor'. It provides mock functionalities for a door/window sensor including fault, tamper, battery status, temperature, and trouble states, along with related methods for testing or simulation purposes.

classes.name: MockLegacyDoorWindowSensor
classes.description: A mock class simulating a legacy door/window sensor device with functionalities to simulate faults, tampering, battery status, and temperature readings.

methods.name: fault
methods.description: Simulates faulting the sensor; sets the cluster to faulted state.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores the sensor from faulted state.

methods.name: faultToggle
methods.description: Toggles the fault state of the sensor.

methods.name: restoreTamper
methods.description: Restores the sensor from tampered state.

methods.name: tamperToggle
methods.description: Toggles the tampered state of the sensor.
